name: Koga Hibari
source:
A mysterious girl. Seems to be involved somehow in the series of incidents.

Favorite Book: Une Vie ((lit. A Woman's Life) by [url=http://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Guy_de_Maupassant]Maupassant[/url].
The type of guys she hates: Men who only talk about theirselves.

[Roughly translated from [url=http://risusoftnosferatu.blog49.fc2.com/blog-entry-4.html]the official website[/url]]
